home.headline: Serivisi nziza yo gusukura ya Kigali
home.subtext: Dusukura ibikoresho by'amashanyarazi, ibikoresho by'inzu, n'ibindi dukoresheje tekinoroji y'ifuro nziza. Teganya mu minota mike, tuza iwanyu muri Kigali.

booking.title: Icyifuzo cy'icyegeranyo
booking.subtitle: Intambwe eshatu zo gusaba icyegeranyo cy'ubusa
booking.step1Text: Hitamo umubare w'ibikenewe kandi ushyireho serivisi ushaka icyegeranyo.
booking.step2Text: Sobanura ubuso bwo gusukura, aho biri, n'igihe cy'icyegeranyo.
booking.step3Text: Tanga amakuru yawe yo kuvugana kugira ngo itsinda ryacu rikohereze icyegeranyo.
booking.descriptionPlaceholder: Tubwire ibyo ukeneye gusukura, ibyangiritse, ibyumba, cyangwa ibindi byifuzo...
booking.summaryText: Reba serivisi wahisemo mbere yo kohereza ubusabe.

dashboard.heading: Amasaha yawe
dashboard.subtext: Reba amakuru ya vuba, ugenzure ibisabwa by'icyegeranyo n'ibindi.
